methods.alignment: preceding observations only, source-bound, bounded age; no frame-counter-only pairing
methods.lag: 25 ms grid, +/-500 ms sweep, no interpolation across source gaps; 200 ms differences require all intermediate grid samples valid
methods.timing_limit: logMonoTime is a host publication timestamp shared by a CAN batch, not per-frame wire time
methods.semantic_limit: Decoded numerical candidates are not OEM names or receiver contracts.

b12_vs_ca_lag.convention: corr(0x160(t), 0x0CA(t+lag)); positive means 0x160 leads; negative means it lags
b12_vs_ca_lag.timing_boundary: Small broad-peak gains and autocorrelated levels do not establish a unique dataflow or ECU delay; compare changes and original transient windows.

conclusions.fine_field: Strongly supported as ego-acceleration/measurement-like on this Camry, not a demonstrated independent acceleration demand.
conclusions.b12_field: Closely follows a chassis acceleration/result-like channel; native timing and the untouched-camera comparison do not establish host command authority.
conclusions.whole_pdu: FRC-origin ADAS publication containing ego-state information; a report to the perception/radar domain is the leading interpretation. The consumer and every field are not recovered.
not_proven: Exact OEM signal names and validity contracts
An exact byte-copy from a different FRC command
Receiver acceptance under healthy adaptive cruise
conclusions.withdrawn: The prior claim that d4 correlation proves combined B4:B5+B12 influence on the protected plane.
conclusions.implementation: No vehicle-control, Panda, authentication, or firmware changes in this audit.
